title: Evaluation of the normalized strict comparison on K-flat representatives
statement: For a scheme morphism f, an adic coefficient datum d, a level n, and a K-flat independent-coefficients complex P with flat terms, the evaluation of the normalized strict reduction comparison on Q.obj P equals the specified finite coefficient pullback comparison.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.8(1), Tags 03EL, 06YY and 015F; representative step of the evaluation proof

proof.text: Evaluate the counit-normalized representative comparison and use the defining counit equation for completedReductionEvaluation. The ordinary scalar mate at level n is the chosen chi comparison, and the restriction/pullback mate supplies the displayed finite map. Tensor balancing identifies the two composites.

proof_origin.place: K-flat representative step in the proof of the evaluation clause

from.place: Proof step: finite evaluation on K-flat representatives

lean.statement:
theorem stratumReduction_evaluation_on_KFlat
    (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (reductionModules X (d.completedRing X)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (hflat : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology X)
      (R := d.completedRing X) (P.X i)) :
    (reductionTowerDerivedEvaluation Y (reductionModuleRing Y (d.completedRing Y)) n).map
        ((stratumReductionIso d f).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (completedReductionEvaluation Y d n).app ((d.pull f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) =
      (stratumTowerEvaluationIso d f n).hom.app ((completedReductionTower X d).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (d.pull f).map ((completedReductionEvaluation X d n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f
          (d.completedRing X) (d.finiteRing X n) (d.completedRing Y) (d.finiteRing Y n)
          (d.projection X n) (d.projection Y n) (d.integralRingIso f) (d.finiteRingIso f n)
          (d.projection_comm f n)).inv.app ((d.reduction X n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
        (reductionDerivedRestrict Y (d.projection Y n)).map
          ((d.chi f n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
